content:
Sorry if this is not the right channel; but is there a way to search for PRs which have not yet had a (potentially adressed) review in the Mathlib reviewer and triage dashboard?

I guess you can sort by lowest comment count, but it would still be nice to be able to do this directly

I don't think we have this yet but I could look into trying to add it. There's a notion of "review cycle" that we keep track of internally and in some inward-facing stats; basically each review cycle is a period of time that a PR is on the review queue, so we could return PRs that are still on review cycle 1.
